Strawberry Cucumber Salad
By: Sharon Chen
Published: Friday, June 30, 2017 - 5:45pm

Ingredients




16 ounces fresh strawberries, sliced
1 large cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced
2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey
1/4 teaspoon kosher salt

Preparation

1 Trim off the top of strawberries and slice them horizontally into thin circles. Peel and slice cucumbers. 2 Arrange slices on a serving platter, overlapping layers. 3 Whisk vinegar and maple syrup together until blended; drizzle over the salad. Then sprinkle with salt. Serve.

About

Take a break from the usual salads with this refreshing 5-ingredient strawberry cucumber salad with a mix of colors, flavors, and textures.
